name: adv_diag_connect_two_streams
source:
// connect() naming two bare stream names rather than instance ports.
Source   SRC(f1, fluid$ = Water, mdot = 1.0, P = 200000, T = 310)
Throttle TH(f2, f3)
Sink     SK(f3)
connect(f1, f2)
m = f3.mdot
h = f3.h

error.message: There are 13 equations and 14 variables. The problem is underspecified and cannot be solved. Free quantity (no defining relation): sk.p. Coupled to: f3.p. A common cause: an element chain with no constitutive law for that quantity — e.g. an efficiency-only machine or rigid pass-through between boundaries leaves its through-flow or a port pressure free; add an orifice/valve/flow-map element or pin a boundary value.
